name: Amasai
meaning: Chief of thirty who joined David
notes: Amasai, a chief of thirty mighty men, joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

name: Amasai
meaning: Priest who blew the trumpet
notes: Amasai, a priest, was among those who blew the trumpet when the Ark of the Covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

name: Amasai
meaning: Levite descendant of Kohath
notes: Amasai, a Levite descended from Kohath, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

name: Amasai
meaning: Levite who helped purify the temple
notes: Amasai, a Levite of the sons of Merari, helped purify the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Amasiah
meaning: Commander who volunteered for God's service
notes: Amasiah, the son of Zichri, was a commander who willingly offered himself for the service of the Lord during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

name: Amaziah
meaning: Simeonite, son of Joshah
notes: Amaziah, the son of Joshah, was a descendant of Simeon.

name: Amaziah
meaning: Levite, son of Hilkiah
notes: Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah, was a Levite of the family of Merari during the time of David.

name: Amaziah
meaning: King of Judah, son of Joash
notes: Amaziah, son of Joash, was the ninth king of Judah who reigned for 29 years.

name: Amaziah
meaning: Priest of Bethel during Amos' ministry
notes: Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, opposed the prophet Amos and told him to leave the kingdom of Israel.

name: Ami
meaning: Family of Solomon's servants
notes: The descendants of Ami (or Amon) were among the returned exiles who were servants of Solomon.

name: Amittai
meaning: Father of the prophet Jonah
notes: Amittai was the father of Jonah, the prophet from Gath-hepher.

name: Ammiel
meaning: Levite gatekeeper during David's reign
notes: Ammiel was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

name: Ammiel
meaning: Father of Machir, David's ally
notes: Ammiel was the father of Machir, who provided assistance to David during his flight from Absalom.

name: Ammiel
meaning: Spy from the tribe of Dan
notes: Ammiel, the son of Gemalli, was the representative from the tribe of Dan among the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

name: Ammihud
meaning: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
notes: Ammihud, a descendant of Judah, was among those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Ammihud
meaning: Father of Talmai, king of Geshur
notes: Ammihud (or Ammihur) was the father of Talmai, the king of Geshur, to whom Absalom fled after killing his brother Amnon.

name: Ammihud
meaning: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim
notes: Ammihud was the father of Elishama, the leader of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness journey.

name: Ammihud
meaning: Father of Shemuel, leader from Simeon
notes: Ammihud was the father of Shemuel, the leader from the tribe of Simeon appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

name: Ammihud
meaning: Father of Pedahel, leader from Naphtali
notes: Ammihud was the father of Pedahel, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

name: Amminadab
meaning: Levite leader during the Ark's transfer
notes: Amminadab was a Levite leader from the Uzzielite clan who participated in the transfer of the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem.

name: Amminadab
meaning: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David
notes: Amminadab was the father of Elisheba, who married Aaron, and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Amminadib
meaning: Noble mentioned in a love song
notes: Amminadib is mentioned in a poetic passage in the Song of Solomon, possibly referring to a noble or prince.

name: Ammishaddai
meaning: Father of Ahiezer, leader of Dan
notes: Ammishaddai was the father of Ahiezer, the leader of the tribe of Dan during the wilderness journey.

name: Ammizabad
meaning: Son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men
notes: Ammizabad was the son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men, and served as his father's second-in-command.

name: Amnon
meaning: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah
notes: Amnon was a son of Shimon and a descendant of Judah.

name: Amnon
meaning: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom
notes: Amnon, David's firstborn son, raped his half-sister Tamar and was later killed by her brother Absalom.

name: Amok
meaning: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
notes: Amok was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and signed the covenant under Nehemiah.

name: Amon
meaning: Governor of Samaria during Ahab's reign
notes: Amon was the governor of Samaria during the reign of King Ahab of Israel.

name: Amon
meaning: King of Judah, son of Manasseh
notes: Amon, the son of Manasseh, was the 15th king of Judah who reigned for two years before being assassinated by his servants.

name: Amorites
meaning: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel
notes: The Amorites were a Canaanite people group who lived in the hill country and were among the enemies the Israelites faced when entering the Promised Land.

name: Amos
meaning: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel
notes: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, called by God as a prophet to Israel.

name: Amos
meaning: Son of Naum in Jesus' genealogy
notes: Amos, an ancestor of Jesus, son of Naum.

name: Amoz
meaning: Father of the prophet Isaiah
notes: Amoz, the father of the prophet Isaiah.

name: Ampliatus
meaning: Believer greeted by Paul in Rome
notes: Ampliatus, a beloved fellow believer greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

name: Amram
meaning: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
notes: Amram was the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, and a member of the tribe of Levi.

name: Amram
meaning: Israelite who married a foreign wife
notes: Amram was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the Exile and agreed to put her away.

name: Amraphel
meaning: King of Shinar, ally of Chedorlaomer
notes: Amraphel, king of Shinar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the Plain.

name: Amzi
meaning: Levite musician, descendant of Merari
notes: Amzi, a descendant of Merari, was a Levite who served as a musician in the temple.

name: Amzi
meaning: Priest in Jerusalem after the Exile
notes: Amzi was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Anah
meaning: Horite, father of Oholibamah, Esau's wife
notes: Anah was a Horite, the father of Oholibamah, one of Esau's wives, and the discoverer of hot springs in the wilderness.

name: Anaiah
meaning: Priest who sealed the covenant
notes: Anaiah was a priest who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during Nehemiah's time.

name: Anaiah
meaning: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
notes: Anaiah was one of the men who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

name: Anak
meaning: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan
notes: Anak was the ancestor of the Anakim, a race of giants who inhabited Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

name: Anamim
meaning: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
notes: The Anamim were a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, and are listed among the nations in the Table of Nations.

name: Anammelech
meaning: Assyrian deity worshiped by Sepharvites
notes: Anammelech was an Assyrian deity worshiped by the Sepharvites, who were among the foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king.

name: Anan
meaning: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
notes: Anan was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Anani
meaning: Descendant of King David
notes: Anani was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

name: Ananiah
meaning: Repairer of the wall in Jerusalem
notes: Ananiah made repairs to a section of the wall near his house during the rebuilding of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

name: Ananias
meaning: High priest during Paul's trial
notes: Ananias, the high priest, presided over Paul's trial and ordered him to be struck on the mouth for his defense.

name: Ananias
meaning: Husband of Sapphira, lied about offering proceeds
notes: Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from the sale of their property and faced divine judgment.

name: Ananias
meaning: Disciple in Damascus, baptized Saul (Paul)
notes: Ananias, a disciple in Damascus, was sent by God to heal and baptize Saul (later known as Paul) after his conversion on the road to Damascus.

name: Anath
meaning: Father of Shamgar, a judge of Israel
notes: Anath was the father of Shamgar, one of the judges who delivered Israel from oppression.

name: Anathoth
meaning: Son of Becher, descendant of Benjamin
notes: Anathoth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Anathoth
meaning: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
notes: Anathoth was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Andrew
meaning: Apostle, brother of Simon Peter
notes: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ and played a significant role in the early church.

name: Andronicus
meaning: Fellow prisoner with Paul, outstanding among the apostles
notes: Andronicus, along with Junia, was a fellow prisoner with Paul and was noted as outstanding among the apostles.

name: Aner
meaning: Amorite ally of Abram
notes: Aner was an Amorite, one of the allies of Abram, who joined him in the battle against the kings who had taken Lot captive.

name: Aniam
meaning: Son of Shemida, descendant of Manasseh
notes: Aniam was a son of Shemida and a descendant of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Anna
meaning: Prophetess who witnessed Jesus' dedication in the temple
notes: Anna, a prophetess and widow, witnessed the dedication of the infant Jesus in the temple and spoke about Him to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

name: Annas
meaning: High priest during Jesus' ministry and trial
notes: Annas, a high priest, played a significant role in the events surrounding Jesus' arrest, trial, and crucifixion, as well as in the early persecution of the apostles.

name: Anthothijah
meaning: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
notes: Anthothijah was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Antipas
meaning: Faithful martyr in Pergamum
notes: Antipas, described as Christ's faithful witness, was martyred in Pergamum, where Satan's throne was said to be.

name: Anub
meaning: Son of Coz, descendant of Judah
notes: Anub was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Apelles
meaning: Approved in Christ, greeted by Paul
notes: Apelles, described as "approved in Christ," was among those greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

name: Aphiah
meaning: Ancestor of King Saul, a Benjamite
notes: Aphiah, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul, the first king of Israel.

name: Apollos
meaning: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul
notes: Apollos, an eloquent and learned Jewish Christian from Alexandria, was an important figure in the early church who worked alongside Paul in spreading the gospel.

name: Appaim
meaning: Son of Nadab, descendant of Judah
notes: Appaim was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Apphia
meaning: Recipient of Paul's letter to Philemon
notes: Apphia, likely a member of Philemon's household, was one of the recipients of Paul's letter to Philemon.

name: Aquila
meaning: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul
notes: Aquila, along with his wife Priscilla, was a Jewish Christian who worked as a tentmaker and played a significant role in the early church, partnering with Paul in his ministry.

name: Ara
meaning: Son of Jether, descendant of Asher
notes: Ara was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Arad
meaning: A Benjamite, son of Beriah.
notes: Arad was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Beriah.

name: Arah
meaning: Son of Shual, an Asherite
notes: Arah, the son of Shual ('Ulla'), was a descendant of Asher.

name: Arah
meaning: Father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite
notes: Arah, whose daughter was married to Shechaniah, was the father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite.

name: Arah
meaning: A Jewish leader whose daughter married Tobiah's son.
notes: Arah's daughter was married to the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

name: Aram
meaning: Son of Shemer, descendant of Asher
notes: Aram was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Aram
meaning: Son of Shem, ancestor of the Arameans
notes: Aram, a son of Shem and ancestor of the Aramean people.

name: Aram
meaning: Son of Kemuel, nephew of Abraham
notes: Aram was the son of Kemuel, who was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor.

name: Aramitess
meaning: Concubine of Manasseh; mother of Asriel
notes: An Aramitess, who was a concubine of Manasseh, gave birth to Machir and Asriel..

name: Aran
meaning: Son of Dishan, descendant of Seir the Horite
notes: Aran was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau's family and the Horite clans.

name: Arba
meaning: Father of Anak, former name of Hebron
notes: Arba was the father of Anak and the namesake of Kiriath-arba, which was the former name of Hebron.

name: Archelaus
meaning: Son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch of Judea
notes: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch over Judea, causing Joseph to fear returning there with Mary and the child Jesus.

name: Archippus
meaning: Fellow soldier and minister in Colossae
notes: Archippus, addressed as a fellow soldier by Paul, was urged to complete the ministry he had received in the Lord.

name: Archites
meaning: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel
notes: The Archites were a people group mentioned in relation to the boundaries of Ephraim's territory and as the origin of Hushai, King David's friend and advisor.

name: Ard
meaning: Son of Benjamin, brother of Bela
notes: Ard, a son of Benjamin, is listed among the descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt during the famine.

name: Ard
meaning: Grandson of Benjamin, son of Bela
notes: Ard, a grandson of Benjamin, is mentioned in the census of the Israelites taken in the wilderness of Moab.

name: Ardon
meaning: Son of Caleb, brother of Jether and Mered
notes: Ardon was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Areli
meaning: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob
notes: Areli, a son of Gad, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jacob and the census of the Israelites in the wilderness.

name: Aretas
meaning: King of the Nabataeans in Damascus
notes: Aretas, the king of the Nabataeans, governed Damascus and tried to arrest Paul.

name: Argob
meaning: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
notes: Argob, along with Arieh, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

name: Aridai
meaning: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
notes: Aridai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

name: Aridatha
meaning: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
notes: Aridatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

name: Arieh
meaning: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
notes: Arieh, along with Argob, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

name: Ariel
meaning: Two lion-like men of Moab killed by Benaiah
notes: Ariel refers to two lion-like men of Moab who were killed by Benaiah, one of David's mighty warriors.

name: Ariel
meaning: One of the leaders summoned by Ezra
notes: Ariel was one of the leaders summoned by Ezra to assist in the return of the exiles to Jerusalem.

name: Arioch
meaning: Captain of Nebuchadnezzar's guard
notes: Arioch, the captain of King Nebuchadnezzar's guard, was commanded to execute the wise men of Babylon but brought Daniel before the king to interpret his dream.

name: Arioch
meaning: King of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer
notes: Arioch, king of Ellasar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

name: Arisai
meaning: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
notes: Arisai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

name: Aristarchus
meaning: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner
notes: Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was a faithful companion of Paul during his missionary journeys and imprisonment.

name: Aristobulus
meaning: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul
notes: Paul sends greetings to those who belong to the household of Aristobulus, suggesting that Aristobulus was a prominent believer in Rome.

name: Arkites
meaning: Canaanite people group descended from Canaan
notes: The Arkites were one of the Canaanite tribes descended from Canaan, the son of Ham, and are mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Armoni
meaning: Son of Saul by Rizpah, killed by Gibeonites
notes: Armoni was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah, killed by the Gibeonites ( 2Sa.21.8 ).

name: Arnan
meaning: Descendant of David's son Solomon
notes: Arnan was a descendant of David's son Solomon ( 1Ch.3.21 ).

name: Arod
meaning: Son of Gad and founder of the Arodite clan
notes: Arod, son of Gad, was the founder of the Arodite clan ( Gen.46.16; Num.26.17 ).

name: Arpachshad
meaning: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
notes: Arpachshad, son of Shem, was born two years after the flood and was an ancestor of Abraham ( Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36 ).

name: Artaxerxes
meaning: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time
notes: Artaxerxes was the Persian king who allowed Ezra and Nehemiah to return to Jerusalem ( Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14 ).

name: Artemas
meaning: Companion of Paul, potential replacement for Titus
notes: Artemas was a companion of Paul who could potentially replace Titus in Crete ( Titus 3:12 ).

name: Arvadites
meaning: Canaanite descendants of Canaan, son of Ham
notes: The Arvadites were a Canaanite People from Canaan, son of Ham ( Gen.10.18; 1Ch.1.16 ).

name: Arza
meaning: Steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah
notes: Arza was the steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah ( 1Ki.16.9 ).

name: Asa
meaning: Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem
notes: Asa was a Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem ( 1Ch.9.16 ).

name: Asa
meaning: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat
notes: Asa was a king of Judah who reigned for 41 years, known for his religious reforms (1Kings 15; 2Chr 14-16).

name: Asahel
meaning: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
notes: Asahel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah ( 2Ch.17.8 ).

name: Asahel
meaning: Levite in charge of tithes under Hezekiah
notes: Asahel was a Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute the tithes and dedicated things ( 2Ch.31.13 ).

name: Asahel
meaning: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner
notes: Asahel, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was a fast runner killed by Abner during a battle ( 2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7 ).

name: Asahel
meaning: Opposed Ezra's dissolution of mixed marriages
notes: Asahel, along with Jahzeiah, opposed Ezra's plan to dissolve mixed marriages among the returned exiles ( Ezra 10:15 ).

name: Asaiah
meaning: Levite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
notes: Asaiah was a Levite leader who assisted in bringing the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem during David's reign ( 1Ch.15.6, 11 ).

name: Asaiah
meaning: Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
notes: Asaiah was a Simeonite leader during the reign of King Hezekiah ( 1Ch.4.36 ).

name: Asaiah
meaning: Merarite Levite, ancestor of Ethan the singer
notes: Asaiah was a Merarite Levite, an ancestor of Ethan the singer ( 1Ch.6.30 ).

name: Asaiah
meaning: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
notes: Asaiah, a descendant of Judah, lived in Jerusalem ( 1Ch.9.5 ).

name: Asaiah
meaning: Servant of King Josiah during Book of Law discovery
notes: Asaiah was a servant of King Josiah sent to consult the prophetess Huldah about the Book of the Law ( 2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20 ).

name: Asaph
meaning: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers
notes: Asaph was a Levite musician and psalmist during David's reign, and his descendants served as temple singers ( 1Ch.6.39; 15:17, 19; 16:5, 7, 37; 25:1, 2, 6, 9; 2Ch.5.12; 20:14; 29:13, 30; 35:15; Ezra 2:41; 3:10; Neh.7.44; 11:22; 12:35, 46; Psalms 50, 73-83 ).

name: Asaph
meaning: Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem
notes: Asaph was a Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile ( 1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17 ).

name: Asaph
meaning: Recorder during King Hezekiah's reign
notes: Asaph served as the recorder during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah ( 2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22 ).

name: Asaph
meaning: Keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time
notes: Asaph was the keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time ( Neh.2.8 ).

name: Asarel
meaning: Son of Jehallelel, from the tribe of Judah
notes: Asarel was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah ( 1Ch.4.16 ).

name: Asen
meaning: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
notes: Asen was an ancestor of 223 individuals who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Asenath
meaning: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim
notes: Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, was given to Joseph as his wife by Pharaoh ( Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20 ).

name: Asharelah
meaning: Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres
notes: Asharelah (or Jesharelah) was a Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres ( 1Ch.25.2, 14 ).

name: Ashbel
meaning: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ashbelite clan
notes: Ashbel was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ashbelite clan ( Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1 ).

name: Asher
meaning: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher
notes: Asher was the eighth son of Jacob, born to Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, and became the founder of the tribe of Asher ( Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36 ).

name: Ashhur
meaning: Descendant of Judah through Hezron
notes: Ashhur, a descendant of Judah through Hezron, was the father (ie founder) of Tekoa ( 1Ch.2.24; 4:5 ).

name: Ashkenaz
meaning: Grandson of Japheth, son of Gomer
notes: Ashkenaz was a grandson of Japheth and son of Gomer, mentioned in the Table of Nations ( Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6 ).

name: Ashpenaz
meaning: Chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court
notes: Ashpenaz was the chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court, responsible for selecting and training young Israelite exiles ( Dan.1.3 ).

name: Ashvath
meaning: Son of Japhlet, descendant of Asher
notes: Ashvath was a son of Japhlet and a descendant of Asher ( 1Ch.7.33 ).

name: Asiel
meaning: Descendant of Simeon
notes: Asiel was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe ( 1Ch.4.35 ).

name: Asnah
meaning: Head of a family of temple servants who returned from exile
notes: Asnah was the head of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile ( Ezra 2:50 ).

name: Aspatha
meaning: One of the ten sons of Haman
notes: Aspatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were executed after their father's downfall ( Est.9.7 ).

name: Asriel
meaning: Son of Gilead, descendant of Manasseh
notes: Asriel was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh ( 1Ch.7.14 ).

name: Asriel
meaning: Son of Manasseh, founder of the Asrielite clan
notes: Asriel was a son of Manasseh and the founder of the Asrielite clan ( Num.26.31; Josh 17:2 ).

name: Asshur
meaning: Son of Shem; father of the Assyrians
notes: Asshur was a son of Shem and is considered the father of the Assyrians ( Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17 ).

name: Asshurim
meaning: Descendant of Abraham through Dedan
notes: Asshurim was a descendant of Abraham through his son Jokshan and grandson Dedan ( Gen.25.3 ).

name: Assir
meaning: Levite ancestor of the prophet Samuel
notes: Assir was a Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet ( 1Ch.6.23, 37 ).

name: Assir
meaning: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath
notes: Assir was a son of Korah and great-grandson of Kohath, from the tribe of Levi ( Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22 ).

name: Asyncritus
meaning: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
notes: Asyncritus was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings ( Rom.16.14 ).

name: Atarah
meaning: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Onam
notes: Atarah was the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah ( 1Ch.2.26 ).

name: Ater
meaning: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
notes: Ater was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity ( Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21 ).

name: Ater
meaning: Head of a family of gatekeepers who returned from exile
notes: Ater was the head of a family of gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity ( Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45 ).

name: Ater
meaning: One of the signers of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
notes: Ater was one of the individuals who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah's reforms ( Neh.10.17 ).

name: Athaiah
meaning: Descendant of Judah who resettled in Jerusalem
notes: Athaiah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the people who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile ( Neh.11.4 ).

name: Athaliah
meaning: Descendant of Benjamin
notes: Athaliah was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of Saul's family ( 1Ch.8.26 ).

name: Athaliah
meaning: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel
notes: Athaliah, the daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, became queen of Judah and ruled for six years before being overthrown ( 2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7 ).

name: Athaliah
meaning: Descendant of Elam who returned from Babylonian exile
notes: Athaliah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra ( Ezr.8.7 ).

name: Athlai
meaning: One of those who agreed to put away foreign wives
notes: Athlai was one of the men who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms ( Ezr.10.28 ).

name: Attai
meaning: One of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior
notes: Attai the son of Zabad was one of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior who joined him at Ziklag ( 1Ch.12.11 ).

name: Attai
meaning: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah
notes: Attai was the grandson of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah ( 1Ch.2.35-36 ).

name: Attai
meaning: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
notes: Attai was a son of King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah ( 2Ch.11.20 ).

name: Augustus
meaning: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus
notes: Augustus, also known as Caesar, was the Roman emperor during the time of Jesus' birth and early life ( Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1 ).

name: Avvim
meaning: Ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area
notes: The Avvim were an ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area before being destroyed by the Caphtorim ( Deut 2:23; Josh 13:3 ).

name: Azaliah
meaning: Father of Shaphan the scribe during Josiah's reign
notes: Azaliah was the father of Shaphan the scribe, who served during the reign of King Josiah of Judah ( 2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8 ).

name: Azaniah
meaning: One of the Levites who sealed the covenant
notes: Azaniah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah ( Neh.10.9 ).

name: Azarel
meaning: One of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag
notes: Azarel was one of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag ( 1Ch.12.6 ).

name: Azarel
meaning: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
notes: Azarel son of Jeroham was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign ( 1Ch.27.22 ).

name: Azarel
meaning: One of those who married foreign women during Ezra's time
notes: Azarel was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra ( Ezr.10.41 ).

name: Azarel
meaning: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
notes: Azarel was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time ( Neh.12.36 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Descendant of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron
notes: Azariah was a descendant of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah ( 1Ch.2.38, 39 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Son of Ethan, descendant of Judah
notes: Azariah was the son of Ethan, a descendant of Judah ( 1Ch.2.8 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests
notes: Azariah was father of Seraiah, father of Ezra. His ancestors served as high priests ( 1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Descendant of Zadok, a priest before Solomon's reign
notes: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, was a priest before the reign of King Solomon ( 1Ch.6.10-11 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: High priest during Solomon's reign, descendant of Zadok
notes: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, served as high priest during the reign of King Solomon ( 1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Son of Nathan, an official in Solomon's court
notes: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was an official in King Solomon's court ( 1Ki.4.5 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Prophet who encouraged King Asa to seek God
notes: Azariah, the son of Oded, was a prophet who encouraged King Asa of Judah to seek God ( 2Ch.15.1 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
notes: Azariah was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah ( 2Ch.21.2 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: A commander who helped crown Joash king
notes: Azariah son of Jeroham was a military commander who supported Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne of Judah.

name: Azariah
meaning: A commander who supported Joash's coronation
notes: Azariah son of Obed was one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

name: Azariah
meaning: High priest who confronted King Uzziah
notes: Azariah, the high priest, confronted King Uzziah when he attempted to burn incense in the temple ( 2Ch.26.17, 20 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Leader who opposed the enslaving of captives
notes: Azariah, along with other leaders, opposed the enslaving of captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz ( 2Ch.28.12 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: A Levite who helped purify the temple
notes: Azariah son of Jehallel was a Merarite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

name: Azariah
meaning: A Levite who helped purify the temple
notes: Azariah son of Jehallelel was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

name: Azariah
meaning: Chief priest during Hezekiah's reign
notes: Azariah, the chief priest from the family of Zadok, served during the reign of King Hezekiah ( 2Ch.31.10, 13 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace
notes: Azariah, also known as Abednego, was one of Daniel's companions who survived the fiery furnace ( Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall
notes: Azariah, son of Maaseiah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during Nehemiah's time ( Neh.3.23, 24 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
notes: Azariah was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time ( Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33 ).

name: Azariah
meaning: Levite who helped the people understand the Law
notes: Azariah was a Levite who helped the people understand the Law during the time of Ezra ( Neh.8.7 ).

name: Azariahu
meaning: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
notes: Azariahu was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah ( 2Ch.21.2 ).

name: Azaz
meaning: Descendant of Reuben; father of Bela
notes: Azaz, a descendant of Reuben, was the father of Bela ( 1Ch.5.8 ).

name: Azaziah
meaning: Levite musician during David's reign
notes: Azaziah was a Levite musician who played the harp during the reign of King David ( 1Ch.15.21 ).

name: Azaziah
meaning: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
notes: Azaziah was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King David ( 1Ch.27.20 ).

name: Azaziah
meaning: Levite during Hezekiah's reign, in charge of offerings
notes: Azaziah was a Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah, appointed to oversee the freewill offerings ( 2Ch.31.13 ).

name: Azbuk
meaning: Father of Nehemiah, who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
notes: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David ( Neh.3.16 ).

name: Azel
meaning: Descendant of Saul, had six sons
notes: Azel, a descendant of Saul, had six sons: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan ( 1Ch.8.37, 38; 9:43, 44 ).

name: Azgad
meaning: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
notes: Azgad was the ancestor of 1,222 (or 2,322) exiles who returned to Jerusalem ( Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17 ).

name: Azgad
meaning: Leader who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
notes: Azgad was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah ( Neh.10.15 ).

name: Aziza
meaning: Descendant of Zattu, had married a foreign woman
notes: Aziza, a descendant of Zattu, was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra ( Ezr.10.27 ).

name: Azmaveth
meaning: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
notes: Azmaveth, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul ( 1Ch.12.3 ).

name: Azmaveth
meaning: Overseer of royal treasuries under King David
notes: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of King David's treasuries ( 1Ch.27.25 ).

name: Azmaveth
meaning: Descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah
notes: Azmaveth, a descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah..

name: Azmaveth
meaning: One of David's mighty men, a Barhumite
notes: Azmaveth the Barhumite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor ( 2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33 ).

name: Azor
meaning: Ancestor of Jesus Christ in the genealogy of Matthew
notes: Azor was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Matthew ( Matt 1:13, 14 ).

name: Azriel
meaning: Ruler of the tribe of Naphtali under David
notes: Azriel son of Jeremoth was the ruler of the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David ( 1Ch.27.19 ).

name: Azriel
meaning: Head of a half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead
notes: Azriel was a head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead ( 1Ch.5.24 ).

name: Azriel
meaning: Official sent to arrest the prophet Jeremiah
notes: Azriel was one of the officials sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest the prophet Jeremiah ( Jer.36.26 ).
